title: Autopay Payment Pattern and the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Late Fee — Desk Guidance
content:
**Desk rule.** On a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account the late fee takes account of how the account was being paid: the payments credited in the last 6 months (dated less than 6 full months before today) are counted, and the number of them that were autopay drafts sets the treatment of the sum of the fee level and the balance add-on.

| Autopay drafts among the payments credited in the last 6 months | Treatment of the fee level plus the balance add-on |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | multiplied by 0.5 (halved) and rounded down to a whole dollar |
| 3 or 4 | multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to a whole dollar |
| fewer than 3 | taken as it stands |

Only payments through the autopay channel count as autopay drafts; one-time payments online, by mail, in store or by phone do not.

## Worked treatments (hypothetical sums)

| Fee level plus balance add-on | 5 or more drafts | 3 or 4 drafts | fewer than 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 45.00 | 22.50, rounded down 22.00 | 33.75, rounded up 34.00 | 45.00 |
| 32.00 | 16.00 | 24.00 | 32.00 |
| 41.00 | 20.50, rounded down 20.00 | 30.75, rounded up 31.00 | 41.00 |
